metadata.title: On the Period Lengths of the Parallel Chip-Firing Game

nodes.name: Parallel chip-firing game
nodes.statement: An automaton on an undirected graph $G$ where each vertex $v$ holds $\sigma(v)$ chips and fires one chip to each neighbor simultaneously whenever $\sigma(v) \ge \textrm{deg}(v)$.

nodes.name: Position
nodes.statement: A position is the ordered pair $(G, \{\sigma(v), v \in G\})$ recording the graph and the nonnegative chip counts on each vertex.

nodes.name: Step operator $U$
nodes.statement: $U\sigma$ is the position resulting after one parallel firing step on $\sigma$; $U^0\sigma = \sigma$ and $U^m\sigma = U U^{m-1}\sigma$.

nodes.name: Period $p(\sigma)$ and transient length $t_0$
nodes.statement: $p(\sigma)$ is the minimal positive integer $p$ such that $U^t\sigma = U^{t+p}\sigma$ for large enough $t$; the minimal such $t$ is the transient length $t_0$.

nodes.name: Firing-neighbor count $\Phi_\sigma(v)$
nodes.section: 2 Parallel Chip-Firing on Simple Connected Graphs
nodes.statement: $\Phi_\sigma(v)$ denotes the number of neighbors $w$ of $v$ satisfying $\sigma(w) \ge \textrm{deg}(w)$.

nodes.name: Terminating position
nodes.section: 2 Parallel Chip-Firing on Simple Connected Graphs
nodes.statement: A position in which no vertices fire after finitely many moves.

nodes.name: Confined position
nodes.section: 2 Parallel Chip-Firing on Simple Connected Graphs
nodes.statement: Vertex $v$ is confined if $\Phi_\sigma(v) \le \sigma(v) \le \Phi_\sigma(v) + \textrm{deg}(v) - 1$; a position is confined if all its vertices are confined.

nodes.name: Indicator $F_v(t)$
nodes.section: 2 Parallel Chip-Firing on Simple Connected Graphs
nodes.statement: $F_v(t) = 1$ if $U^t\sigma(v) \ge \textrm{deg}(v)$ and $F_v(t) = 0$ otherwise; the indicator that vertex $v$ fires at step $t$.

nodes.name: Complement position $\sigma_c$
nodes.section: 2 Parallel Chip-Firing on Simple Connected Graphs
nodes.statement: The complement of a confined position $\sigma$ replaces $\sigma(v)$ chips on each vertex $v$ with $2\,\textrm{deg}(v) - 1 - \sigma(v)$ chips.

nodes.name: Fire-count $u_t(\sigma, v)$
nodes.section: 2 Parallel Chip-Firing on Simple Connected Graphs
nodes.statement: $u_t(\sigma, v) = |\{ s : 0 \le s < t,\; U^s\sigma(v) \ge \textrm{deg}(v) \}|$, the number of times $v$ fires in the first $t$ steps.

nodes.name: Side fire-counts $F_L(\sigma), F_R(\sigma)$ and $\alpha_t(L, m)$
nodes.statement: $F_L(\sigma), F_R(\sigma)$ count vertices firing in $L, R$; $\alpha_t(L, m) = \sum_{v \in L}(u_{m+t}(\sigma, v) - u_m(\sigma, v))$ counts firings in $L$ over $t$ steps from step $m$.

nodes.name: Per-vertex fire-count $d_t(v, m)$
nodes.statement: $d_t(v, m) = u_{m+t}(\sigma, v) - u_m(\sigma, v) = \sum_{i=m}^{m+t-1} F_v(i)$, the number of times $v$ fires in $t$ steps starting at step $m$.

nodes.name: Step-update rule
nodes.section: 2 Parallel Chip-Firing on Simple Connected Graphs
nodes.statement: $U\sigma(v) = \sigma(v) + \Phi_\sigma(v)$ if $\sigma(v) \le \textrm{deg}(v) - 1$, and $U\sigma(v) = \sigma(v) + \Phi_\sigma(v) - \textrm{deg}(v)$ if $\sigma(v) \ge \textrm{deg}(v)$.

nodes.name: Fire-difference equation
nodes.statement: For $v \in L$ on $K_{a,b}$: $U^t\sigma(v) - \sigma(v) = \alpha_t(R) - b\,u_t(\sigma, v)$.

nodes.name: Bitar's conjecture
nodes.statement: $p(\sigma) \le |V(G)|$ for every position $\sigma$ of the parallel chip-firing game on every graph $G$.

nodes.name: Tree period dichotomy (Bitar-Goles)
nodes.statement: Every position on a tree graph has period $1$ or $2$.
conclusions: $p(\sigma) \in \{1, 2\}$ for any position $\sigma$ on a tree

nodes.name: Kominers-Kominers stabilization for abundant chip totals
nodes.statement: If $\sum_{v \in G} \sigma(v) \ge 4|E(G)| - |V(G)|$ on a connected graph, the position has period $1$ with polynomial transient length.

nodes.name: Bound for complete graph $K_n$ (Levine)
nodes.statement: Bitar's conjecture holds for the complete graph: $p(\sigma) \le n$ for every position on $K_n$.

nodes.name: Kiwi et al.\ counterexample
nodes.statement: There exists a graph $G$ and a position whose period is at least $\exp(\Omega(\sqrt{|V(G)|\log|V(G)|}))$, disproving Bitar's conjecture in general.

nodes.name: Pigeonhole Principle
nodes.statement: Among any $n+1$ integers, two are congruent modulo $n$.

nodes.name: $2\,\textrm{deg}(v) - 1$ chip bound (Lemma 2.1)
nodes.section: 2 Parallel Chip-Firing on Simple Connected Graphs
nodes.statement: For sufficiently large $t$, $U^t\sigma(v) \le 2\,\textrm{deg}(v) - 1$ for all $v \in G$ in any game with nontrivial period on a connected graph $G$.

nodes.name: Confinement bound (Lemma 2.2)
nodes.section: 2 Parallel Chip-Firing on Simple Connected Graphs
nodes.statement: If $\sigma(v) \le 2\,\textrm{deg}(v) - 1$, then $\Phi_\sigma(v) \le U\sigma(v) \le \Phi_\sigma(v) + \textrm{deg}(v) - 1$.

nodes.name: Complement-equivariance lemma
nodes.section: 2 Parallel Chip-Firing on Simple Connected Graphs
nodes.statement: For any confined position $\sigma$, $U(\sigma_c) = (U\sigma)_c$.

nodes.name: Period equals complement period
nodes.section: 2 Parallel Chip-Firing on Simple Connected Graphs
nodes.statement: For all positions $\sigma$ on $G$, $p(\sigma) = p(\sigma_c)$.

nodes.name: All-equal firing characterization (Prop.\ 2.5, prop:alleq)
nodes.section: 2 Parallel Chip-Firing on Simple Connected Graphs
nodes.statement: $U^t\sigma = \sigma$ iff $u_t(\sigma, v) = u_t(\sigma, w) = k \ge 0$ for all $v, w \in G$.

nodes.name: Fire-count gap on a side (Lemma 3.1, lem:diff1)
nodes.statement: If $\sigma$ is confined on $K_{a,b}$, $v, w \in L$, and $\sigma(v) \le \sigma(w)$, then $u_t(\sigma, v) \le u_t(\sigma, w) \le u_t(\sigma, v) + 1$ for all $t \ge 0$.

nodes.name: Divisibility forces equal firing on a side (Lemma 3.2, lem:ndiv)
nodes.statement: If $\sigma$ is confined and $a \mid \alpha_t(L)$, then $u_t(\sigma, v) = \alpha_t(L)/a$ for all $v \in L$.

nodes.name: Cross-side firing transfer (Lemma 3.3, lem:t1)
nodes.statement: If $\sigma$ is confined and $\alpha_t(L) = ka$, then $u_{t+1}(\sigma, v) - u_1(\sigma, v) = k$ for all $v \in R$.
conclusions: $u_{t+1}(\sigma, v) - u_1(\sigma, v) = k$ for all $v \in R$

nodes.name: Two-step propagation of divisibility (cor:t1)
nodes.statement: If $a \mid \alpha_t(L, m)$, then $d_t(v, m) = d_t(v, m+2) = k$ for all $v \in L$ and $a \mid \alpha_t(L, m+2)$.

nodes.name: Sufficient condition for a period (Lemma 3.4, lem:periodt)
nodes.statement: If $\sigma$ is confined and $\alpha_t(L, m) = ka$ with $F_v(m) = F_v(m+t)$ for all $v \in L$, then $U^t\sigma = \sigma$.

nodes.name: Side-count strengthening (cor:periodt)
nodes.statement: If $\sigma$ is confined and $\alpha_t(L, m) = ka$ with $F_L(m) = F_L(m+t)$, then $U^t\sigma = \sigma$.

nodes.name: Two-step divisor proposition (prop:t1t2)
nodes.statement: Let $t_1, t_1 + t_2$ be the two smallest positive integer solutions of $\alpha_t(L, 0) \equiv 0 \pmod{a}$ for confined $\sigma$. Then $p(\sigma) \mid t_1 + t_2$ and $t_1 + t_2$ is even.

nodes.name: Period upper bound on $K_{a,b}$ (cor:lea)
nodes.statement: For $\sigma$ on $K_{a,b}$: if $p(\sigma)$ is odd, $p(\sigma) \le \min(a, b)$; if even, $p(\sigma) \le 2\min(a, b)$.

nodes.name: Existence of all bipartite periods (prop:existpos)
nodes.statement: For every $1 \le k \le \min(a, b)$, there exist positions $\sigma_k, \sigma_{2k}$ on $K_{a,b}$ with periods $k$ and $2k$.
conclusions: a position with period $k$ exists on $K_{a,b}$
a position with period $2k$ exists on $K_{a,b}$

nodes.name: Characterization of periods on $K_{a,b}$ (main theorem)
nodes.statement: $p$ is a possible period of a position on $K_{a,b}$ iff $p \in \{ i : 1 \le i \le \min(a,b) \} \cup \{ 2i : 1 \le i \le \min(a,b) \}$.

nodes.name: $c$-partite period construction
nodes.section: 4 Periods of Games on the Complete $c$-Partite Graph
nodes.statement: On $K_{a_1, \ldots, a_c}$ with $a_1 \ge \cdots \ge a_c$, the constructed position has period $(c-j) a_c - k + 1$ for all $0 \le j \le c-1$ and $1 \le k \le a_c$, so all periods $1, \ldots, c \min(a_1, \ldots, a_c)$ are achievable.
conclusions: a position with period $(c-j) a_c - k + 1$ exists on $G$

nodes.name: Period-$k$ position $\sigma_k$ on $K_{a,b}$
nodes.statement: $L(0) = (1, 2, \ldots, k-1, b, b, \ldots, b)$ and $R(0) = (1, 2, \ldots, k-1, a, a, \ldots, a)$ exhibits period $k$ on $K_{a,b}$.

nodes.name: Period-$2k$ position $\sigma_{2k}$ on $K_{a,b}$
nodes.statement: $L(0) = (0, 1, \ldots, k-2, k-1, k-1, \ldots, k-1)$ and $R(0) = (1, 2, \ldots, k-1, a, \ldots, a)$ exhibits period $2k$ on $K_{a,b}$.

nodes.name: Period-11 position on $K_{6,5,5,4}$
nodes.section: 4 Periods of Games on the Complete $c$-Partite Graph

nodes.name: Period-5 position on $K_{2,2,1}$
nodes.statement: $S_1(0)=(2)$, $S_2(0)=(1,2)$, $S_3(0)=(0,3)$ on $K_{2,2,1}$ has period $5$, exceeding the periods produced by the Section-4 construction.

nodes.name: Bitar's conjecture for $c$-partite graphs
nodes.statement: Does $p(\sigma) \le |V(G)|$ hold for every position on every complete $c$-partite graph?

nodes.name: Bitar's conjecture for vertex-regular and general bipartite graphs
nodes.statement: Bound the periods of positions on vertex-regular graphs and on general (non-complete) bipartite graphs.

nodes.name: Subcycle period conjecture
nodes.statement: Every period length of a parallel chip-firing game on $G$ is a divisor of the order of some subcycle of $G$, or perhaps the least common multiple of the orders of disjoint subcycles of $G$.

nodes.name: Proof of Lemma 2.1
nodes.section: 2 Parallel Chip-Firing on Simple Connected Graphs
nodes.statement: Cite Kominers-Kominers: a vertex with $\le 2\,\textrm{deg}(v)-1$ chips stays so under $U$; if some vertex retains $\ge 2\,\textrm{deg}(v)$ chips after many steps, all vertices fire (period 1).

nodes.name: Proof of Lemma 2.2
nodes.section: 2 Parallel Chip-Firing on Simple Connected Graphs
nodes.statement: Case split on whether $\sigma(v) < \textrm{deg}(v)$ or $\sigma(v) \ge \textrm{deg}(v)$, applying the firing rule in each case.

nodes.name: Proof of complement-equivariance lemma
nodes.section: 2 Parallel Chip-Firing on Simple Connected Graphs
nodes.statement: Direct computation: a vertex fires in $\sigma_c$ iff it does not fire in $\sigma$, then $U(\sigma_c)(v) = (U\sigma)_c(v)$ algebraically.

nodes.name: Proof of Proposition prop:alleq
nodes.section: 2 Parallel Chip-Firing on Simple Connected Graphs
nodes.statement: If all $u_t$ equal $k$, equation \eqref{eq:firing} gives $U^t\sigma = \sigma$. Conversely, take $v'$ with maximal $u_t$ and propagate equality through the connected graph by induction.

nodes.name: Proof of Lemma lem:diff1
nodes.statement: By induction on $t$: base case from sortedness; inductive step splits on whether $u_t(\sigma,v) = u_t(\sigma,w)$ or differs by 1, using equation \eqref{eq:firediff}.

nodes.name: Proof of Lemma lem:ndiv
nodes.statement: By Lemma~\ref{lem:diff1}, $u_t(\sigma,v) \in \{m, m+1\}$. Counting gives $\alpha_t(L) = am + z$ with $z < a$; divisibility forces $z = 0$.

nodes.name: Proof of Lemma lem:t1
nodes.statement: Confinement and equation \eqref{eq:firediff} for $v \in R$ yield $-1 < k - (u_t(\sigma,v) - u_1(\sigma,v)) < 2$, then a one-step argument promotes the value to $k$.

nodes.name: Proof of Lemma lem:periodt
nodes.statement: Apply Lemma~\ref{lem:ndiv} to get $d_t(v,m) = k$ on $L$; the $F_v$ equality gives $d_t(v, m+1) = k$; combine with equation \eqref{eq:t1} to invoke Proposition~\ref{prop:alleq}.

nodes.name: Proof of Corollary cor:periodt
nodes.statement: Sort $L$ by chip count at step $m$; firing sets are upward-closed in this order, and the gain $k_0 - k$ is uniform, so the firing sets at $m$ and $m + t$ coincide.

nodes.name: Proof of Proposition prop:t1t2
nodes.statement: Show $\tau = t_1 + t_2$ even by parity arguments via Corollary~\ref{cor:t1}; then a descent argument on $F_L(m + n\tau)$ produces an $n$ with $F_L(m + n\tau) = F_L(m + (n+1)\tau)$, invoking Corollary~\ref{cor:periodt}.

nodes.name: Proof of Corollary cor:lea
nodes.statement: Replace $\sigma$ by $U^{t_0}\sigma$ to assume confinement; Pigeonhole on $\alpha_m(L) \bmod a$ over $2a+1$ steps yields $t_1 + t_2 \le 2a$, then apply Proposition~\ref{prop:t1t2}.

nodes.name: Proof of Proposition prop:existpos
nodes.statement: Construct $\sigma_k$ and $\sigma_{2k}$ explicitly and trace the firing pattern; after $k$ (resp.\ $2k$) steps every vertex has fired exactly once, so Proposition~\ref{prop:alleq} gives the period.

nodes.name: Proof of main theorem
nodes.statement: Combine Corollary~\ref{cor:lea} (no period outside the set) with Proposition~\ref{prop:existpos} (every period in the set is realized).

nodes.name: Proof of $c$-partite construction
nodes.section: 4 Periods of Games on the Complete $c$-Partite Graph
nodes.statement: Identify $F_\sigma(t)$ at each step of the constructed position; show every vertex fires exactly once in $a_c(c-j) - k + 1$ steps, then apply Proposition~\ref{prop:alleq}.

nodes.name: Counterexample on even-cycle bipartite graph
nodes.statement: Doubling the length of each cycle in the Kiwi et al.\ counterexample yields a graph with only even cycles (a general bipartite graph) for which Bitar's conjecture fails.

nodes.name: Reduction by chip removal
nodes.statement: Removing chips from each vertex without changing $F_v(t)$ for any $v, t$ may simplify games and aid inductive arguments.
